name: Gekkougahara Miaya
source: Gekkougahara Miaya is a member of the Future Foundation and is the Branch Office 7 Director. Her responsibility as the director is providing security to deal with cyber threats and development of new ways to cure despair. She, along with the other Future Foundation Directors, is forced to participate in the Final Killing Game.
